mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(o.pay_amount), 0) from oms_order o where
select count(1) from pos_product p where coalesce(p.stock, 0) > 0

select date_format(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as dateLabel, coalesce(sum(o.pay_amount), 0) as sales, count(1) as orders from oms_order o where and o.create_time >= #{startTime} and o.create_time < #{endTime} group by date_format(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by dateLabel asc

select coalesce(c.category_name, 'Uncategorized') as name, coalesce(sum(oi.product_quantity), 0) as value from oms_order_item oi inner join oms_order o on o.id = oi.order_id left join pos_product p on p.product_id = oi.product_id left join pos_category c on c.category_id = p.product_category_id where group by coalesce(c.category_name, 'Uncategorized') order by value desc

select oi.product_name as name, coalesce(sum(oi.product_quantity), 0) as count from oms_order_item oi inner join oms_order o on o.id = oi.order_id where and o.create_time >= #{startTime} and o.create_time < #{endTime} group by oi.product_id, oi.product_name order by count desc limit #{limit}

select o.order_sn as orderNo, coalesce(nullif(o.member_username, ''), 'Customer') as customer, coalesce(o.pay_amount, o.total_amount, 0) as amount, cast(o.status as char) as status, date_format(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime from oms_order o order by o.create_time desc limit #{limit}
